phases_covered: Capture the rendered HTML with Playwright
Download static assets via network request interception
Rewrite asset paths to local relative URLs
Serve locally with a static HTTP server
key_warnings_mentioned: Stripe uses heavy JS rendering — simple wget/curl won't capture full fidelity
Animations (GSAP/custom) won't run in a static clone
Authenticated CDN tokens may cause 403s on some assets
Web fonts may not load due to strict CORS headers on CDN
Anti-scraping detection may block headless browsers
Dynamic content varies by viewport and A/B test bucket
Legal/ToS: do not republish or redistribute Stripe's copyrighted assets
Inline JS makes external API calls that will silently fail locally
file:// protocol will hit CORS restrictions — must use a local HTTP server
Conditional assets (video backgrounds, WebGL) may require multiple capture passes
